modules.name: entrypoints
modules.role: User-facing interfaces: CLI, OpenAI-compatible HTTP server, and Python LLM APIs that accept requests and route them into the runtime.

modules.name: engine
modules.role: Compatibility engine facade that points to V1 engine implementation and shared engine argument/protocol helpers.

modules.name: v1/engine
modules.role: Main serving orchestrator: request lifecycle, input/output processors, engine-core client wiring, and process-level coordination.

modules.name: v1/core
modules.role: Inner scheduling core: KV cache planning, scheduling loop, structured outputs manager, and request stepping decisions.

modules.name: v1/executor
modules.role: Execution backend manager that launches and monitors worker processes (single/multiprocess/ray/external modes).

modules.name: v1/worker
modules.role: Per-device worker runtime that initializes distributed state, loads model runners, and executes inference steps.

modules.name: model_executor
modules.role: Model execution stack: model registry, loaders, layers, kernels bridges, and runner logic for many model families.

modules.name: distributed
modules.role: Distributed communication/runtime primitives for TP/PP/DP groups, KV transfer, and weight/collective utilities.

modules.name: config
modules.role: Strongly-typed configuration system (VllmConfig and sub-configs) that controls runtime, parallelism, kernels, and policies.

modules.name: inputs
modules.role: Prompt/input contracts and normalized request payload types used before scheduling and model execution.

modules.name: tokenizers
modules.role: Tokenizer abstraction and model-specific tokenization helpers for text and multimodal request preparation.

modules.name: renderers
modules.role: Prompt rendering/conversion layer (chat/template/prompt conversion) between API payloads and engine-ready forms.

modules.name: multimodal
modules.role: Registry and processing pipeline for image/video/audio style inputs and media preprocessing hooks.

modules.name: plugins
modules.role: Extensibility surface for general plugins, IO processors, and LoRA resolver plugins loaded into runtime.

modules.name: lora
modules.role: LoRA adapter requests, layers, and integration logic that injects adapter behavior into model execution.

modules.name: kernels
modules.role: Python-level optimized kernel wrappers/utilities used by model execution for fast attention and math ops.

modules.name: compilation
modules.role: Compilation/passes and graph optimization path to improve runtime throughput across supported hardware.

modules.name: csrc
modules.role: Native C++/CUDA custom ops and low-level runtime pieces backing high-performance kernels.
